scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A climbing number
scenes.caption: A fictional trading-game screen enters the Decision Lab. Vihaan watches its balance climb while Aditi asks what the number represents. Nobody trades or connects accounts; the figure is supplied screen data.
scenes.speech: A fictional trading-game screen enters the Decision Lab. Vihaan watches its balance climb while Aditi asks what the number represents. Nobody trades or connects accounts; the figure is supplied screen data.
scenes.dialogue: A screen can display a number without transferring funds.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Crowded praise
scenes.caption: Several testimonial cards repeat the same wording and picture arrangement. Aditi groups the copies rather than counting them as independent witnesses. These cards show screen content, without a separate provider record of received withdrawal.
scenes.speech: Several testimonial cards repeat the same wording and picture arrangement. Aditi groups the copies rather than counting them as independent witnesses. These cards show screen content, without a separate provider record of received withdrawal.
scenes.dialogue: Repeated praise is not independent payment evidence.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A further payment
scenes.caption: The withdrawal panel now demands ₹600 before it will release the displayed balance. Vihaan records this as a new payment request, not a completed cash-out. Paying creates further exposure without proving receipt of the promised withdrawal.
scenes.speech: The withdrawal panel now demands ₹600 before it will release the displayed balance. Vihaan records this as a new payment request, not a completed cash-out. Paying creates further exposure without proving receipt of the promised withdrawal.
scenes.dialogue: A demand is not evidence of an incoming payment.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Inspect the gap
scenes.caption: The learner pauses and asks which independent record would support receipt. A screenshot of the same game cannot fill the gap. Their teacher distinguishes interface appeal from evidence about funds, without any test payment.
scenes.speech: The learner pauses and asks which independent record would support receipt. A screenshot of the same game cannot fill the gap. Their teacher distinguishes interface appeal from evidence about funds, without any test payment.
scenes.dialogue: Do not buy evidence from the claimant.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Separate the records
scenes.caption: The supplied case contains no completed recipient-side provider entry for a withdrawal. Its confirmed received amount is therefore ₹0 within these records. Aditi separates the game balance, preventing display arithmetic becoming a claim of received income.
scenes.speech: The supplied case contains no completed recipient-side provider entry for a withdrawal. Its confirmed received amount is therefore ₹0 within these records. Aditi separates the game balance, preventing display arithmetic becoming a claim of received income.
scenes.dialogue: The conclusion is limited to the supplied records.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Help without another fee
scenes.caption: Vihaan takes the claim-and-evidence note privately to a trusted adult. They retain the payment demand and relevant fictional references without publishing account details. No recovery is promised. The operator remains unidentified; support does not require solving every unknown.
scenes.speech: Vihaan takes the claim-and-evidence note privately to a trusted adult. They retain the payment demand and relevant fictional references without publishing account details. No recovery is promised. The operator remains unidentified; support does not require solving every unknown.
scenes.dialogue: Ask for support before taking another financial step.
